headlines.text: It was 2021 when Christian Cage made their first appearance under the AEW banner against Frankie Kazarian, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.19 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle. One of the most highly anticipated debuts in AEW's early history ? Cage returning to the ring for the first time in seven years, having been kept a closely guarded surprise signing since his shocking Royal Rumble return just months earlier.

That Wednesday in 2021, Kenny Omega chalked up their 50th recorded AEW match ? a genuine milestone, facing Good Brothers & Omega vs. Lucha Brothers & Laredo Kid on Dynamite, rated 7.62 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle in a fast-paced six-man clash.
Rewind to 2021, when Cassidy & Taylor vs. Miro & Sabian settled things in an Arcade Anarchy Tag match on Dynamite, rated 8.09 ? an excellent showing in a back-and-forth tag team affair.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2021, Allie left that name behind for good, stepping out as The Bunny after 2 matches under the old identity, on Dynamite.
2021 brought us this moment: it was the first-ever encounter between Jon Moxley and Cezar Bononi on Dynamite, rated 4.20.
2021 brought us this moment: it marked the first-ever meeting between Cody Rhodes and QT Marshall in an Exhibition Match on Dynamite, rated 4.07.
